description: PostgreSQL 18 time parsing, precision rounding, 24:00:00, arithmetic, COPY, indexing, and range validation
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_time (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, raw_value TIME, rounded_value TIME(3) UNIQUE);
SELECT id, raw_value, rounded_value FROM type_matrix_time ORDER BY raw_value, id;

SELECT '4:05 AM'::time AS am, '4:05 PM'::time AS pm, '12:00 AM'::time AS midnight, '12:00 PM'::time AS noon, '040506.789'::time AS compact, 'allballs'::time AS allballs, '04:05:06+02'::time AS ignored_zone;
SELECT '00:00:00.0000005'::time AS tie_even, '00:00:00.0000015'::time AS tie_odd, '12:34:56.123456789'::time AS rounded_microseconds;

SELECT '01:00:00'::time + interval '2 hours 3 minutes 4.5 seconds' AS plus_interval, '01:00:00'::time - interval '2 hours' AS minus_interval, interval '1.000001 seconds' + '12:00:00'::time AS reverse_plus, '04:05:06.5'::time - '01:02:03.25'::time AS time_difference;
SELECT '24:00:00'::time + interval '0 seconds' AS normalized_end, '24:00:00'::time - '00:00:00'::time AS day_difference;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_time WHERE raw_value = '4:05 PM'::time;
SELECT raw_value FROM type_matrix_time WHERE id = 'copied';
